bbd6051ccb.en:
Insights

  • Autonomous systems dominate the program — localization / SLAM, routing, redundancy / safety and trajectory prediction.
  • Learning is pervasive but safety-framed: RL, graph networks and behavior trees are paired with redundancy, verification and uncertainty tuning.
  • MBSE is maturing from notation to automation — Colored Petri Nets, Capella/UML workflows and AI-assisted modeling.

Vision

  • Fail-operational autonomy without a human fallback (on-demand redundancy, safe-by-design behavior trees).
  • Digital twins linking cyber, human and physical systems for training and control.
  • Energy-efficient, neuromorphic AI (spiking networks) for real-time edge perception.

Implications for us

  • Treat autonomy as a System of Systems — coordinate multi-vendor constituents with integrated safety and security.
  • Adopt model-driven / MBSE practices (CPN, Capella) to raise software quality and shorten CPS design.
  • Invest in GPS-denied localization and uncertainty-aware planning for real industrial and emergency use.
bbd6051ccb.zh:
洞察

  • 自主系统主导了本届议程：定位 / SLAM、路径规划、冗余 / 安全以及轨迹预测。
  • 学习方法无处不在，但以安全为前提：RL、图网络和行为树都与冗余、验证和不确定性调优结合使用。
  • MBSE 正从记法走向自动化：Colored Petri Nets、Capella/UML 工作流和 AI 辅助建模。

愿景

  • 无需人工兜底的故障可运行（fail-operational）自主能力（按需冗余、设计即安全的行为树）。
  • 连接信息、人和物理系统的数字孪生，用于训练和控制。
  • 面向实时边缘感知的高能效类脑 AI（脉冲网络）。

对我们的启示

  • 将自主能力视为体系（System of Systems）：在集成安全与信息安全的前提下，协调多供应商的组成系统。
  • 采用模型驱动 / MBSE 实践（CPN、Capella），提高软件质量并缩短 CPS 设计周期。
  • 投入 GPS 拒止环境下的定位和感知不确定性的规划，面向真实的工业和应急场景。
